parsed.rationale: Both participating records have is_test=true: `PlaycutMetadataMockCache.set` in `PlaycutMetadataServiceCachingTests.swift` and `EntityResolverMockCache.set` in `DiscogsAPIEntityResolverCachingTests.swift` are test-only mock cache implementations. Although the Jaccard similarity is 0.7, each mock is scoped to its own distinct test class (`PlaycutMetadataMockCache` vs. `EntityResolverMockCache`) exercising different system-under-test collaborators, making the near-duplication an expected consequence of parallel test fixture design rather than a production-code smell. Consolidating them would couple unrelated test suites and obscure the intent of each fixture.
